description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Name', which implements a transformation for HTML attributes, specifically converting 'name' attributes to 'id' attributes under certain conditions. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library's attribute transformation system.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Name
classes.description: A class that transforms the 'name' attribute into an 'id' attribute when appropriate, to handle deprecated or legacy HTML attribute scenarios.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array, converting 'name' to 'id' if certain conditions are met (e.g., 'HTML.Attr.Name.UseCDATA' is false, and 'name' exists but 'id' does not).
